change.summary: Reviewed ingredient and resource policies define the only system-market outcome and exact quote/cap fields; finished meals remain outside the universal Market.

modifiers.notes: Selector member details are emitted by behavior queries so different per-item values stay in one canonical source set.

rationale.purpose: Expose reviewed BUY_AND_SELL or NONE decisions while unknown and progression-protected items remain fail-closed.
rationale.decision_source: Docs/DEVELOPMENT.md economy ownership and policy contract

introduced.summary: Existing reviewed policies were first linked into Atlas v2; individual original introduction commits remain unresolved.

history.summary: Applied cap classes approved by the user, excluded 18 finished meals, and retained only one sellable recipe edge: wheat to dried wheat at 1:1 with no price uplift.
Linked the canonical policy source as one reusable selector and enabled recipe-impact lookup per matched item.

notes: Cap classes are common crops 64/2048, raw food ingredients 32/512, processed intermediates 16/256, farmable drops and valuable minerals 16/128, and rare natural resources 2/32.
Prepared meals are explicit NONE policies and remain tradable only through separate player-owned shop mechanics.

The exact installed Brewery recipe converts one wheat into one dried wheat; both sell for two base copper, while either costs four to buy, so guaranteed NPC proceeds cannot exceed ingredient purchase cost even at the same demand multiplier.
unresolved: Static Atlas evidence does not prove every runtime-only acquisition path; any future commodity without exact recipe or acquisition evidence remains fail-closed.
